_comment: ARCNAVE modernization P5 (O5) dependency policy allowlist — read by scripts/audit-policy-gate.js. Only HIGH/CRITICAL advisories need an entry here; MODERATE/LOW stay informational (npm audit still reports them, see dependency-scan-baseline.md). Every entry needs a real 'reason' and 'recorded' date — this is an accepted-risk log, not a blanket suppression.

accepted.reason: Arbitrary file read/execute only when the Vitest UI server is listening. Dev/test tooling only — never runs in `npm run build`'s shipped bundle, and this repo's CI/local workflow never starts the Vitest UI server. Fix needs vitest@3 (currently pinned ^2.1.4), its own breaking config-surface migration.
`server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths — dev server only, not present in the production build artifact. Fix needs vite@7 (currently pinned ^5.4.0), a breaking bump.
